theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (M O : Set (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P m), IsOpen O → MeasurableSet M → ContinuousOn ξ M → (∀ x ∈ M, ∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ x ∈ O, ∃ B : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen B ∧ x ∈ B ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ B → C ω = ∫ z in M, ξ z ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) z) ∂μHE[m]) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ O → C ω = ∫ z in M, ξ z ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) z) ∂μHE[m]
